verse.unicode: ਇਹ ਜਗਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਕੋਈ ॥

transliteration.english: eeh jag meet na dhekhio koiee ||

en.bdb: In this world, I have not found any true friend.

verse.unicode: ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: sagal jagat apanai sukh laagio dhukh mai sa(n)g na hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: The whole world is attached to its own pleasures, and when trouble comes, no one is with you. ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਸਗਰੇ ਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੇ ॥

transliteration.english: dhaaraa meet poot sanaba(n)dhee sagare dhan siau laage ||

en.bdb: Wives, friends, children and relatives - all are attached to wealth.

verse.unicode: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਨਰ ਕਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਭ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: jab hee niradhan dhekhio nar kau sa(n)g chhaadd sabh bhaage ||1||

en.bdb: When they see a poor man, they all forsake his company and run away. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਕਹਂਉ ਕਹਾ ਯਿਆ ਮਨ ਬਉਰੇ ਕਉ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥

transliteration.english: kaha(n)au kahaa yiaa man baure kau in siau neh lagaio ||

en.bdb: So what should I say to this crazy mind, which is affectionately attached to them?

verse.unicode: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਸਕਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: dheenaa naath sakal bhai bha(n)jan jas taa ko bisaraio ||2||

en.bdb: The Lord is the Master of the meek, the Destroyer of all fears, and I have forgotten to praise Him. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛ ਜਿਉ ਭਇਓ ਨ ਸੂਧਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਤਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਨਉ ॥

transliteration.english: suaan poochh jiau bhio na soodhau bahut jatan mai keenau ||

en.bdb: Like a dog's tail, which will never straighten out, the mind will not change, no matter how many things are tried.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਜ ਬਿਰਦ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਉ ਲੀਨਉ ॥੩॥੯॥

transliteration.english: naanak laaj biradh kee raakhahu naam tuhaarau leenau ||3||9||

en.bdb: Says Nanak, please, Lord, uphold the honor of Your innate nature; I chant Your Name. ||3||9||
